title: Every create, delete, move, and reassign action produces a toast with an Undo option
permissions_required: Schedule: Edit (Delete for the delete action; spec §14.1).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Delete.
2. Schedulable lines and an existing shift are available.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
steps: 1. Create a shift - watch for a toast.
2. Move a shift to another day - watch for a toast.
3. Reassign a shift to another technician - watch for a toast.
4. Delete a shift - watch for a toast.
expected: 1. Each of the four actions produces a toast notification.
2. Every toast offers an Undo option.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
